activities.name: [Monumental Etching: Shadow Marked] Limited-Time Challenge
activities.description: Complete various [Umbral Monument] challenges in the [Marked by Dark Shadows] series to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate I].

activities.name: [Yuanyuan's Blazing Stoves] Fun & Games Event
activities.description: Visit the [Si's Painting] area in [Wuling], manage [Yuanyuan Manor Inn], complete the corresponding Session Tasks, and increase your Inn Milestones to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×1000 and [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Spirit's Restoration] Sign-In Event
activities.description: Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [Spirit's Restoration HH Permit]×5.

activities.name: [All the Inky Hues] Guide Event
activities.description: Visit the [Si's Painting] area in the region of [Wuling] and complete specified missions to earn event rewards such as [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Season of Phantasia] (Echoes of War)
activities.description: New season [Season of Phantasia] is available. This season features 3 cycles, each including 3 stages. [Season of Phantasia] adds 3 new stages. Clear all new stages on Normal difficulty to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×300.

activities.name: [Carly's Verdant Anthology] Camera Event
activities.description: Complete camera missions to earn event rewards that include: [Oroberyl]×1500, [Portrait Frame: Carly's Verdant Anthology], [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Monumental Etching: Forest of Maras] Limited-Time Challenge
activities.description: Upon the release of the [Murmurs of the Deep Forest] series, the [Monumental Etching: Forest of Maras] limited-time event will begin. During the event, complete various [Umbral Monument] challenges to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate II].

activities.name: [Contingency Readiness] Limited-Time Event
activities.description: During the event, complete specified missions every day to receive rewards including [Sanity Usage Permit], [Emergency Sanity Booster], [Wuling Artificing Catalyst], and [Coolant Gel].

activities.name: [Arena of Games] Challenge Event
activities.description: During the event, take on [Arena of Games] challenges to earn Arena Points. Reach every tier in [Arena Milestone] to earn rewards including [Oroberyl]×1200 and [Mark of Perseverance].

activities.name: [Back to the Rustics] Narrative Event
activities.description: Complete the side mission [Back to the Rustics] to earn [Oroberyl]×600, [Elementary Cognitive Carrier], and other rewards.

activities.name: [The Stars Are With Me] Sign-In Event
activities.description: Sign in for a total of 7 days to earn rewards such as [The Stars Are With Me HH Permit]×5.

activities.name: [Contingency Contract: Indigo Experimental Operation] Challenge Event
activities.description: During the event, you can select any combination of Test Criteria for the challenge, and try to complete it. Complete event missions to earn rewards such as [Portrait: Silverblade Medal], [Portrait Frame: Contingency Respondent] and [Vitrified Indigo]. Spend [Vitrified Indigo] at the [Secret Sanctuary] to exchange for great rewards including [Oroberyl]×2000, [Sticker: Contingency Resolved], and [Advanced Progression Selection Crate II].

activities.name: [Season of Fervor] (Echoes of War)
activities.description: New season [Season of Fervor] is available. This season features 3 cycles, each including 3 stages. [Season of Fervor] adds 3 new stages. Clear all new stages on Normal difficulty to claim rewards including [Oroberyl]×300.

activities.name: [Sanity Supply] Limited-Time Event
activities.description: During the event, complete specified missions every day to claim Sanity Supply rewards: [Sanity Usage Permit] and [Emergency Sanity Booster].
